source.note: Starter annual smoke alarm check interval

likelyCauses.description: The alarm battery may be low

steps: Check whether the alarm uses a 9V or AA battery.
Remove the old battery and fit the correct replacement.
Press the test button and confirm the chirping stops.
callProIf: The alarm continues after a fresh battery

source.note: Starter smoke alarm battery steps; verify the alarm manual

stopMessages.gas: Please don't use switches or flames. Open windows, leave the room, and call {number} now.
stopMessages.electrical: If you can do so safely, switch off power at the breaker. Move away and call a qualified professional at {number}.
stopMessages.water_near_power: Stay clear of the water. If you can switch off power without going near it, do so; call a qualified professional at {number}.
stopMessages.fire: Leave the building and call {number} from a safe place.
stopMessages.carbon_monoxide: Leave the building immediately and call {number} from outside.

source.note: General emergency and safety wording starter defaults
